description: DE-Pack: the special depreciation allowance of § 7g Abs. 5 EStG — 40 % of the cost for assets acquired from 2024, freely distributed over the year of acquisition and the four following ones. Two numbers and one window, and all three are pack data: the rate was 20 % until the end of 2023 and became 40 % afterwards, which is exactly the kind of figure that has no business in a jurisdiction-free core. On 50,000.00 the allowance is 20,000.00; here 15,000.00 of it is taken in the first year, on top of the ordinary 10,000.00 for a five-year life. What the core does NOT check is whether the business is entitled to it — § 7g ties the allowance to a profit limit and a share of business use, both facts about the business rather than about the books, and a bookkeeping library that pretended to know them would be lying convincingly. It checks what it can: not more than the budget, not outside the window.
